calculation.expression: lag1(((-momentum20 / vol40) if cross_sectional_dispersion20 > rolling_median126(dispersion20) else (momentum20 / vol40)))
calculation.description: Use cross-asset 20-day return dispersion to select regime: in unusually dispersed markets use volatility-scaled cross-sectional reversal; in compressed markets use volatility-scaled momentum. Signal is lagged one completed session to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history cross-asset benchmark validation over 15 tradable instruments; conservative interpretation due to approximately 11.2 valid names per date. Recent 10-day IC/ICIR were -0.00524/-0.0172 over 180 sessions, 0.00653/0.0212 over 500, and 0.01903/0.0613 over 750, so recency is weaker than full-history admission.
